pool.text: Kolachi was formally founded as a fortified village by Sindhi Baniyas.
The name Karachee was used for the first time in a Dutch report.
The Talpurs built the Manora Fort to protect the local harbour.
The British East India Company captured Karachi after opening naval fire.
British administrators organized the Karachi Conservancy Board to control a cholera epidemic.
The Karachi Conservancy Board became the Karachi Municipal Commission.
City administration transformed into the Karachi Municipal Corporation with a mayor.
The first international cricket match in Karachi was held between Sindh and Australia.
Sindh was established as a separate province making Karachi its capital.
The Dow University of Health Sciences was established as a medical institution.
Karachi was made the national capital of Pakistan following independence.
Riots erupted leading to the flight of most Hindu population to India.
The Federal Capital Territory of Pakistan was created from Karachi areas.
The University of Karachi was founded as Pakistan's largest university.
The Institute of Business Administration was founded with Wharton School support.
The Karachi Development Authority came into existence to manage local land.
The Dawood University of Engineering and Technology opened for degree programmes.
The Karachi district was divided into three distinct administrative units.
The local stock exchange was rated as Asia's best-performing stock market.
At least one million flood affectees took refuge in the city.
